description: Search the District of Columbia Code by TOPIC/keyword, and/or browse one TITLE's chapters and sections. Pass "query" to search official section headings (catchlines) — e.g. "landlord eviction notice", "concealed carry permit", "homicide" — across all 51+ titles or, with "title" also set, within just that title. Pass "title" alone (no query) to list every section under that D.C. Code title, acting as a chapter-list/browse tool. Matches official headings only (DC Council does not publish a full-text search over statutory body text). Call dc_statute with a result's citation for the full text. Keyless.

limit.description: Max results. Default 10 (search) or 100 (title listing); max 50 (search) or 500 (title listing).

query.description: Topic or keywords to match against official section headings, e.g. "eviction notice".

title.description: A D.C. Code title number to filter to, or to list on its own (chapter-list mode), e.g. "22" or "27A".

name: dc_search
title: Dc Search
